target_customer: Mapping, location data and business data companies (named: Radar, TomTom, Data Axle, Matador)
problem: Maps and business databases go stale; Reprompt uses AI research agents to gather and verify live information about points of interest and businesses.
business_model: Usage and data products (location data, enrichment API, KYB checks, custom datasets); pricing not found
product_category: AI agents for business and location data

founders.name: Lukas Martinelli
prior_employers: Mapbox (General Manager of Search, seven years)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page, created open source mapping developer tools with about 15k GitHub stars.

technical_complexity.rationale: Web, vision and document reading agents that verify business facts at scale; the site claims 220M businesses covered (unverified).

defensibility.rationale: A growing verified business database may compound, but agent based research is replicable by data vendors and LLM providers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found in the sources reviewed.

market_need_then: Mapping companies need fresh point of interest data; the company names Radar and TomTom as users of its agents.

branding.domain_note: Uses repromptai.com, suggesting reprompt.com was not available; not confirmed.

brand_strength.rationale: Several unrelated products share the Reprompt name (Chrome extension, prompt tools), the name reflects its earlier LLM evaluation product, and no press about the brand was found.

pivots.from: No-code LLM evaluation and prompt improvement tool (per YC listing and older descriptions)
pivots.to: AI agents for location and business data

outcome_analysis: Reprompt is an active YC W24 company whose focus moved from LLM evaluation tooling to AI data agents for mapping companies. Funding is unverified and the site carries an acquisition banner that no other source confirms, so the outcome is unresolved.
notes: The fetched repromptai.com page summary mentions a banner saying Reprompt 'has been acquired by Rippling'; an outcome search found no report of this, so status stays none and the claim is unverified. Funding unverified: Bouncewatch lists 500K pre-seed from Y Combinator (2024-03); Latka claims no outside funding; VCBacked lists Y Combinator and Rebel Fund. No rounds recorded. Competition at founding: dated sources not found. Round added: a $500K pre-seed dated March 2024 from Y Combinator, reported by Bouncewatch and an Extruct listing (one aggregator lists 2024-02-14); this rests on databases only, no press release found. VCBacked also lists Rebel Fund as an investor without a date, so it is not attached to the round.
